title: AirPodsDesktop — Full AirPods Support on Windows & Linux #Shorts
description:
AirPodsDesktop is a desktop user experience enhancement program for AirPods on Windows and Linux. Battery levels for each earbud, auto ear detection, low battery notifications, and a clean system tray interface — all the features Apple reserves for macOS.
